headline.text: New year, new limits. Is your plan ready for

subhead: Most 2027 benefit limits are final. Here’s what changed, what’s still pending, and the dates your team should have on the calendar.

heroCalendar.caption: New limits take effect for calendar-year plans

numbers.title: The 2027 numbers at a glance
numbers.lead: Final figures from the IRS and HHS for plan years beginning in 2027, with 2026 for comparison.

watchOut.text: HSA-qualified plans must stay under the lower IRS out-of-pocket limits, not just the ACA maximum. And any family plan with an out-of-pocket max above $12,000 needs an embedded individual limit of $12,000 or less.

rows.title: Lock in 2027 plan designs
rows.detail: Check out-of-pocket maximums, HDHP limits, and employee contributions against the new numbers.

rows.title: Line up ACA e-filing
rows.detail: If you file your own Forms 1094-C / 1095-C, IRS e-file credentials can take weeks to obtain. Confirm your vendor or apply now, not in January.

rows.title: Distribute SBCs and annual notices
rows.detail: Include the Summary of Benefits and Coverage and required notices with enrollment materials.

rows.title: Gag clause attestation (self-funded plans)
rows.detail: Carriers attest for fully insured plans. Self-funded plans file through the CMS portal, or get written confirmation that the TPA files for them.

rows.title: California statements (self-funded plans)
rows.detail: Furnish Forms 1095-B or 1095-C to enrolled California residents. This is earlier than the federal date, and the federal “available on request” option may not satisfy California.

rows.title: Furnish Forms 1095-C
rows.detail: Mail them, or post a notice that forms are available on request.

rows.title: CMS creditable coverage disclosure
rows.detail: Due within 60 days of the plan year start for plans that offer prescription drug coverage.

rows.title: E-file Forms 1094-C / 1095-C
rows.detail: Electronic filing deadline with the IRS. Self-funded plans covering California residents also file with the Franchise Tax Board.

items.title: Telehealth
items.body: HDHPs can cover telehealth before the deductible without affecting HSA eligibility, now permanently.

items.title: Direct primary care
items.body: Qualifying arrangements no longer block HSA eligibility if fees stay under monthly limits.

items.title: Dependent care FSA
items.body: The annual limit rose to $7,500, up from $5,000.

items.title: Bronze plans
items.body: Bronze and catastrophic Marketplace plans now count as HSA-compatible.

checklist.title: Your year-end checklist
items: Confirm in-network out-of-pocket maximums, including embedded individual limits, are within $12,000 / $24,000.
Confirm HSA-qualified plans meet the 2027 IRS deductible and out-of-pocket limits.
Test employee contributions against the 10.22% affordability threshold.
Update plan documents and employee materials for 2027 HSA limits, and watch for the FSA limit.
Name one owner for your annual notice calendar, plus a backup.

contact.title: Questions about your plan’s compliance?
contact.body: Our team can review your 2027 plan designs, notices, and reporting with you.

disclaimer: Figures current as of October 2026 and subject to change. Deadlines shown are for calendar-year plans and 2026 reporting. This article is for informational purposes only and should not be considered legal or tax advice.
